identity.one_liner: Affordable trend-led streetwear for India's Gen-Z, dropping new styles weekly.
identity.target_customer: 18-26 year olds in metro and tier-2 cities, price-sensitive, discovers styles through Reels and influencer hauls, shops in bursts around drops/sales/festive occasions.

tone.voice_notes: Talks like a friend hyping the next drop, not a catalog. Leans on countdowns, emoji, creator-style captions.

insights.observation: Reels of real customers styling drops outperformed static product-grid posts on save/share rate across the last quarter's drop campaigns.
Flat percentage-off flash-sale codes with a 48-hour countdown produced the largest week-over-week order spike of any campaign type in the last 2 quarters.
Adding a short try-on video plus a size-chart callout to the PDP visibly cut cart abandonment in the trend-chaser cohort versus product-photo-only pages.
Ethnic-crossover capsule drops reliably outsell the usual streetwear SKUs in the 3 weeks before Diwali/wedding season.

The Social proof / UGC-led variant ('Real customers, real hauls') for Vamp Streetwear, targeting Mainly our trend-chasers and discount-chasers segments - Gen Z, 18-25, metro and tier-2, the ones who follow drops on Instagram Reels and buy in bursts around sales., scored 4.7/10 average across persona reactions; evaluation recommended to narrow.

The Problem-solution variant ('Tired of choosing one or the other?') for Vamp Streetwear, targeting Mainly our trend-chasers and discount-chasers segments - Gen Z, 18-25, metro and tier-2, the ones who follow drops on Instagram Reels and buy in bursts around sales., scored 4.5/10 average across persona reactions; evaluation recommended to narrow.
